schönste.en: Schönste (word): Any of several smaller places in Germany and Austria

lenz.en: free of water, dry, empty (of a ship, especially its ballast tank)

seim.en: Seim (word): a viscous fluid, especially syrup or honey

wacht.en: Wacht (word): guard, guard duty, watch, vigil

tränken.en: tränken (inf.): to water (animals), give to drink

auslöschen.en: to extinguish, to put out (e.g. a fire)

gebühren.en: to be due, to be owed, to rightfully belong
